findings.question: q-trigonometry-unit-circle-0011
findings.quote: Angles are measured in degrees. Which statement about the unit-circle point $(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$ is true?
findings.problem: The stem supplies the coordinate order that the keyed choice asks students to identify. A student can copy the order in $(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$ to select “Cosine is always the first coordinate and sine is always the second coordinate” without knowing the unit-circle relationship.
findings.fix: Remove the coordinate formula from the stem; ask which statement about a unit-circle terminal point is true.
